notes.problem: Camouflage scalp behind the kicker and hook, sausage hand, brown mid tone field.
notes.fix: Camera to desk height, crop to forearm and hands at the keys, no head in the top half, lid the one source, near black field.

notes.problem: Mannequin head under the kicker and hook, a detached pink hand, a flat warm brown field, a mid tone frame.
notes.fix: Over the right shoulder with the head out of frame, both hands in the lid's light, the lawn and near black sky behind the lid.

notes.problem: Low poly head crosses the kicker, mitten hands, brown mid tone field.
notes.fix: Over the shoulder crop with the head out of frame left and above the type band; sky to near black.

notes.problem: Flat brown rectangle reads as a placeholder; no window; mannequins; near chair a black slab.
notes.fix: A modelled window with mullions, sill and the warm seam beyond, the room's one source, the lectern in its pool.

notes.problem: Collar clips on the figures, a blank brown rectangle as the biggest lit area, no window.
notes.fix: A sill height window of last light on the left as the one source; remove the collar mesh or recrop to shoulders in shadow.

notes.problem: White collar tab on every seated figure; the window reads as a blank brown board, so the room's light has no source.
notes.fix: Remove the collar tab; model the back wall rectangle as a real window with mullions and a warm exterior whose light rakes the lectern and floor.

notes.problem: Blown white bottom third, floating laptop, unreadable sheet.
notes.fix: Key off the desk top, contact shadow under the laptop, the lid's shadow across the sheet's edge.

notes.problem: Mid grey desk top fills the bottom 40 percent, a bright strip past the desk's edge, a plum gradient behind the lid, a product shot.
notes.fix: Drop the camera and tilt up so the lawn and seam show over the lid, crop the desk top into shadow, the sheet ends on the desk, the page toward L* 70.

notes.problem: Pale desktop floods the lower third, sheet a white bar, laptop hovers.
notes.fix: Narrow the key to a pool under the laptop, contact shadows under its feet, sheet turned off axis.

notes.problem: Desk under a fifth of the frame; mannequin walker with white hair beside the desk.
notes.fix: Camera low and close behind the walker, desk a third of the frame, walker cropped to legs and shoes.

notes.problem: Walker's hair a pale block, oak foliage under the hook.
notes.fix: Push the oak into a silhouette, a dark hair or cap material on the walker.

notes.problem: Mannequin walker with a white column of hair; walker and desk under a third of the frame.
notes.fix: Dark hair or a hood; camera in so walker and desk fill a third of the frame; vary the tufts.

notes.problem: Far lids alias, uniformly bright, the block a busy grey grid.
notes.fix: Cut the instanced lids to the planned low level and mip the far rows so only the hero lid reads bright.

notes.problem: Far lids alias into moire; hero small.
notes.fix: Plain low emissive on the instanced far lids; hero forward and larger, at least 400 px tall.

notes.problem: Pavers as floating plywood, inlays flat red, desk small.
notes.fix: Sink pavers flush with dark soil joints, low roughness inlays with one specular streak, desk a third of the frame tall.

notes.problem: Desk small at lower left, right half empty lawn with floating labels.
notes.fix: Lower and push the camera along the walk; labels against their inlays.
